title: UNIBEN Admission, Clearance, School Charges & Official Student Portal
summary: For UNIBEN students, confirm the admission on JAMB CAPS, use the university's student portal to process acceptance and clearance, and pay the school-charge invoice generated for your own course and session.
feeLabel: School charges: use official student invoice
feeNote: The university's 23 November 2025 notice says 2025/26 fees were unchanged from the preceding session, but does not establish a universal 2026/27 undergraduate amount. The university's general fee tables are not a substitute for a current session and faculty-specific invoice.
timeline: The October and November 2025 instructions apply to 2025/26 entrants. No 2026/27 clearance or school-charge deadline is inferred from them.
requirements: JAMB registration number and a matching provisional admission record on JAMB CAPS
Access to the personal email used to receive a UNIBEN Student ID and password during acceptance processing
JAMB result slip, institution-copy admission letter, O-level certificate or result, and matching result-verification scratch card details
Birth record or age declaration, certificate of local-government origin and university-requested affidavits for clearance
steps: Open the University of Benin's official student portal and verify that your provisional offer matches the admission recorded on JAMB CAPS.
For the documented 2025/26 acceptance route, sign in with your JAMB registration number; supply a personal email to obtain a Student ID and new password, then sign in as a student.

Open ACADEMICS then CLEARANCE to begin the acceptance/clearance workflow; pay the acceptance invoice through the official payment route and refresh your payment status by signing out and signing back in.
Upload the required birth, identity and examination records, preview your clearance form and submit it for university approval; keep the acceptance receipt and request confirmation.

After your student account is enabled for the relevant session, select PAYMENT then SCHOOL CHARGES, generate the exact fee invoice for your programme, and pay through the university's Remita instructions.

After the school has approved clearance and credited your school-charge payment, download the confirmed receipt, select your semester courses on the student portal and show the registered course list to the departmental course adviser for validation.
notes: Do not reuse a 2025/26 fee or deadline as the 2026/27 amount; admission and payment stages can change each session.
The university's older general school-charge table and acceptance-fee table may not reflect your college, level, new charges or current invoice.

University of Benin's official 5 October 2026 JUPEB announcement separately lists a ₦23,000 foundation-programme application fee, excluding bank charges. That is NOT undergraduate tuition, clearance or the Post-UTME fee.
Only the university's own portal and published instructions should control payment; MyNigeriaGuide does not collect school fees or student passwords.

title: University of Ibadan Admission, School Fees, Screening & Clearance
summary: The University of Ibadan's 2026/27 admission screening required a ₦3,000 portal-access payment and ₦2,000 screening fee. Those registration windows have ended; accepted students must check the official portal for their own session's acceptance, physical-clearance and school-levy instructions.
feeNote: ₦3,000 admission portal access plus ₦2,000 screening was published for the 2026/27 screening cycle; this is not tuition, hostel or acceptance. UI's ₦50,000 acceptance notice was for 2025/26 and should not be reused as a 2026/27 fee.
timeline: The 2026/27 UTME screening registration ran 22 June–19 July; Direct Entry registration ran 3–16 August 2026. Both periods are past as of 12 October 2026.
requirements: JAMB registration number and the university's published first-choice/eligibility screening conditions for the relevant academic session
Valid O-level results, uploaded and matched to JAMB records, plus any Direct Entry qualification in the candidate's admission category
Active email address and admission portal access for payment confirmation and university announcements
For admitted candidates attending physical clearance, original and photocopied admission letter, result slip, birth record and supporting documents listed for their own session
steps: Check University of Ibadan's admissions announcement for the correct UTME or Direct Entry session before attempting registration; the 2026/27 public registration windows have ended.
Open the UI admission portal with your JAMB registration number and follow its sign-in/recovery procedure for the relevant exercise.

When an official application window is active, generate payment through the portal and pay the session-specific portal-access and screening amounts shown on its university notice; save the successful payment receipt.
Check your JAMB CAPS admission status and the university's admission portal separately; an application payment alone is not an admission offer.
After a formal offer, read the university's current acceptance and clearance notices, pay only the documented session fee and assemble the required originals, photocopies and university forms.
Use the student portal for school levies or course registration when the university opens it; distinguish technology, utility, faculty and medical-professional levies where stated.
notes: University of Ibadan's 2025/26 notice gave ₦50,000 acceptance and a March 2026 physical clearance exercise; those are historical, not live 2026/27 instructions.
The 2025/26 university payment guide distinguishes bundled/school fees from separate technology and utility levies and special fees for some programmes.
Do not treat the screening fee, acceptance fee, hostel charge and eventual student invoice as the same payment.
Admissions records, school charges and clearance requirements must be checked through the university and JAMB, not unofficial WhatsApp payment links.

title: UNN 2026/27 Admission Screening, Acceptance Fee & Clearance Guide
summary: University of Nigeria Nsukka's 2026/27 screening notice specified ₦2,000 application and ₦3,300 processing charges; the August 5 registration deadline has passed. New entrants should use the UNN portal, accept a confirmed JAMB CAPS offer, then obtain the correct session and list-specific acceptance invoice before clearance.
feeNote: The 2026/27 ₦2,000 application + ₦3,300 processing charges are distinct from school and acceptance fees. For 2025/26 UNN published different acceptance amounts across primary and certain supplementary lists; do not extrapolate a single amount to every admission batch.
timeline: The 2026/27 published screening period ran 15 July–5 August 2026 and has passed. Further admissions and resumption/clearance notices must be checked separately.
requirements: 2026 JAMB UTME registration with UNN as first choice and the screening eligibility announced for the candidate's category
O-level results uploaded to JAMB CAPS and UNN portal, with consistency between JAMB and exam records
Direct Entry result or qualification verification where the candidate is applying through JAMB Direct Entry
JAMB admission letter, UNN admission notice, evidence of age, verified examination records and payment receipts for eventual faculty clearance
steps: Open UNN's official 2026/27 screening announcement and confirm your entry category and whether any newly published application window exists; the original 5 August deadline is past.
During an authorised window, enter the JAMB registration number through UNN's portal, generate an official invoice and pay the stated application and processing charges through Remita.
Complete the requested biodata, subject grades and supporting document uploads; review all names, grades and birth dates before submitting and print the acknowledgement slip.
Check admission through JAMB CAPS and the official UNN admission-status channel; a screening result or recommendation is not the same as an accepted CAPS offer.
If admitted, generate an acceptance invoice from the UNN portal for the specific admission list and session; use its official receipt and acceptance form, not an amount copied from a different batch.
Arrange the faculty clearance package, verification of O-level results, school-fee invoice and course registration according to the current student instructions.
notes: UNN's 2025/26 primary notice listed ₦30,000 acceptance, while a later supplementary notice described ₦50,000 for a different cohort; fee amount must be tied to the candidate's actual letter and invoice.
UNN's earlier freshman instructions describe supporting documents, signed acceptance, result verification and course registration. The current faculty may modify this list.
Do not submit altered examination results or share result scratch-card details with unauthorised agents.
Verify the correct current portal and whether any deadline has been extended via www.unn.edu.ng before paying.

title: UNILAG 2026/27 Post-UTME, Direct Entry, Student Fees & Clearance
summary: For the 2026/27 University of Lagos screening, the university set ₦5,500 in combined application/administrative charges for Post-UTME and ₦3,500 for Direct Entry. The published application windows are over; verify admission and freshers' fee notices using UNILAG's official portals.
feeNote: UNILAG identifies ₦2,000 application plus ₦3,500 administrative for the 2026/27 Post-UTME, and ₦3,500 for its separate Direct Entry registration. Neither figure is undergraduate school fees. Its older 2023 obligatory-fee schedule should not be represented as the 2026/27 amount.
timeline: 2026/27 Post-UTME registration ended 8 July, online test took place 27–31 July, and Direct Entry registration ran 9–22 September 2026; verify any later official new notice.
requirements: University of Lagos first-choice JAMB record and the 2026/27 eligibility criteria for Post-UTME or Direct Entry
Five qualifying O-level credits in the required subjects including English and Mathematics as specified in UNILAG's announcement
An active personal email address for university examination, admission and application communications
JAMB result or Direct Entry acknowledgement and the relevant academic qualification documents for the chosen route
steps: Open UNILAG's official Admissions announcements and identify the published entry route for your session: Post-UTME, Direct Entry or a separately announced degree programme.
Use the university applications portal to start an Undergraduate application and sign in using the admission-cycle JAMB details and surname format specified by UNILAG.
For a future authorised screening window, generate the official payment advice, pay the published charge and return to complete the form; save your payment and exam-pass receipts.
Upload examination or Direct Entry qualification results, check that O-level data also appears on JAMB CAPS, and preview every application field before submitting.
Check university and JAMB announcements for the offer outcome; do not assume a passed screening or cut-off mark guarantees admission.
After admission, use UNILAG's current student-registration notice and personal invoice to determine obligatory charges, medical or faculty requirements and physical or online screening appointments.
notes: UNILAG says its 2026/27 Post-UTME exercise was online and it authorised no outside CBT centre or agent to conduct it.
UNILAG's publicly published 2023 obligatory-charge schedule separates courses with laboratories from courses without; it cannot safely be labelled a 2026/27 fee table.
A UNILAG postgraduate, distance-learning or foundation application has separate fees and eligibility from the full-time undergraduate Post-UTME.
Do not pay third-party bank accounts for guaranteed admission, exam access, an appointment or clearance.

title: LASU 2026/27 Admission Screening, LACACA Clearance & Student Fees
summary: Lagos State University has separate official portals for its 2026/27 undergraduate admission screening and Central Admissions Clearance (LACACA). Screening eligibility and student-clearance payments depend on the student's route and verified admission record.
feeLabel: Screening and clearance: check LASU invoice
feeNote: The LASU screening platform refers applicants to its dedicated payment link after login; it does not provide a universal school-fee or LACACA amount on that landing page. The university requires separate acceptance, medical and clearance payments as applicable; pay only a current official invoice.
timeline: The 2026/27 LASU admission-screening and LACACA portals are listed. Portal accessibility does not prove any applicant can still submit screening, nor does it establish an individual clearance deadline.
requirements: 2026 JAMB registration number and LASU first-choice institution status in JAMB CAPS
Relevant O-level credits uploaded to JAMB CAPS at an accredited CBT centre
Appropriate Direct Entry, JUPEB or UTME qualification under LASU's documented candidate categories
For admitted students, JAMB registration number, matching surname, acceptance and medical payment proof and documents requested in LACACA
steps: Open the official LASU 2026/27 admissions-screening portal and choose the UTME, Direct Entry or JUPEB applicant category that matches your record.
Confirm the university's current eligibility and that your O-level results and choice of institution appear correctly on JAMB CAPS before entering a JAMB number and surname.
If your application window is authorised, sign in, use the LASU-listed payment link, return with its transaction reference and enter your biodata and qualifications for screening.
Check the school's official admissions notices and JAMB CAPS for a provisional admission decision; do not pay a clearance fee on an unverified offer.
Once admitted, open LASU's official Central Admissions Clearance portal and sign in with the JAMB number and surname, then use the school's payment and document-upload instructions for LACACA.
Keep official acceptance, medical, clearance and school-fee receipts separate; confirm matriculation-number assignment and any faculty follow-up using university notifications.
notes: LASU's current admissions platform specifies 195 as the 2026/27 minimum UTME score for its listed route; admission still depends on course criteria, JAMB and university processing.
The 2026/27 LACACA site is separate from the admission-screening site, so a screening payment does not complete admitted-student clearance.
LASU's official 2025/26 LACACA notice described acceptance, medical and clearance payments before clearance. Use current 2026/27 instructions for any fee amount or timing.
Applicants of Lagos State origin may face a separate indigeneship verification procedure; it is not proof of admission.
